title: AEB System Architecture

The feature-level behaviour of detecting an imminent forward collision, warning the driver and requesting service braking is specified in REQ-AEB-009.
rationale: Architecture allocation requirement derived from the AEB feature decomposition. The feature behaviour is separated into REQ-AEB-009 so that architecture and behaviour can be verified independently.

acceptance_criteria.then: Exactly the seven listed application SWCs are allocated to the AEB partition, and no additional AEB application SWC is allocated outside the partition.
expected_outputs: Seven SWCs present and allocated as listed
Feature behaviour traced to REQ-AEB-009
acceptance_criteria.tolerance: Exact match on SWC names and allocation.
